input: What is the refund rate for Home category products?

expected_result.derivation: Definition (same shape as sql-01): approved refunded Home item quantity divided by total Home item quantity sold. psql: 2 approved-refunded units / 24 total units = 0.0833, checked against the 23 raw Home order_item rows by hand. Plausible wrong reading: refund count of any status divided by order_item row count instead of unit quantity = 3/23 = 0.1304 - this exact value came back from the live system, so it's a real, not hypothetical, mistake. Tolerance 0.01 covers rounding; the correct and wrong answers are 0.047-0.05 apart, well outside it.

generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS total_refunds, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.id) AS total_order_items, ROUND(CAST(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) / COUNT(DISTINCT oi.id) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS refund_rate_pct FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON oi.id = r.order_item_id WHERE p.category = 'Home' LIMIT 500
failed_checks: expected_result: no returned value within 0.01 of 0.0833 (or 8.33 as a percent)
